Scoring notes: 

• 
To earn the first point a response must present at least a difference and a quotient and a correct 

evaluation. For example,

• 
Simplification of the numerical value is not required to earn the first point, but any simplification 
must be correct. 

• 
The second point can be earned without the first point if the response has the correct setup but an 
incorrect or no evaluation of the average rate of change. The Mean Value Theorem need not be 
explicitly stated provided the conditions and conclusion are stated.
